title: A selection of entries for the meeting
description: The person chooses the events, questions and notes they want to discuss with a professional.

blocks.text: In the session it is hard to recall everything you wanted to say about the past few weeks.

quote.text: I am usually dishonest in these appointments however I have been logging my feeling every day using this app and showing it to my doctors when I see them.

blocks.text: Save short notes as life goes on, then choose a period and the entries. Before handing it over, show everything the selection contains and allow a comment of your own to be added.
A summary helps prepare the conversation; interpretations have to be distinguishable from the person’s original entries.
